questionText:

Psychological testing revealed that children in this community exhibited marked attentional deficits, lower reading comprehension scores, and high learned helplessness compared to peers from quieter, lower-density neighborhoods. options.text: It operates in direct violation of the fundamental conservation laws of Self and Personality.

detailedSolution:

According to standard NCERT Self and Personality specifications, Assessment of Personality is fully consistent with established principles and does not violate conservation laws.
